schemaNotes.stableId: Permanent registry identity; do not derive evidence filenames from display copy.
schemaNotes.routeKey: The ScreenId/SheetId when one exists; otherwise an explicit embedded/global key.
schemaNotes.workspace: personal, business, shared, or global. A route with workspace-dependent dispatch lists both components.
schemaNotes.themeHandling: theme-provider means the component reads the resolved Light/Dark palette directly or through shared themed primitives; platform-alert means Android/iOS owns alert chrome.
schemaNotes.states: Important visually distinct states. Each state id is stable within its owning surface.
schemaNotes.designOwnerHints: Pinned-design comparison starting points, not proof of parity. null means no direct owner was found at the pinned SHA.

captureHarness.productionDefault: inert unless EXPO_PUBLIC_MELO_PARITY_CAPTURE=true is baked into a dedicated QA build
captureHarness.persistenceIsolation: capture mode bypasses persisted-state load/write, notifications, billing reconciliation, and widget sync

dataStateDependencies: state prop or derived pots length

embeddedSheetsAndModals.discovery: Mounted sheet/modal components outside SheetId plus WorkspaceSheet and business forms

alertCallsites.discovery: rg Alert.alert across apps/mobile/app and apps/mobile/src/folio excluding tests

knownRegistryRisks.evidence: ScreenId and BusinessOperationsScreen support business-deductions, but BUSINESS_SURFACE_REGISTRY does not list it.
No ScreenBusinessFilingPayroll or business-filing-payroll route was found at pinned design SHA.
No direct pinned design component exists; explicit owner assignment is required before visual closure.
Platform chrome is allowed to differ, but trigger context and return state still require native capture.
